title: One-off destroy decisions: Assault Cannon and Courageous to the End
description: These two decisions pick one ship to destroy. They used to open the staged hit panel, whose confirm was refused by the client ('Workflow is no longer pending'), so they could not be answered. They now show the plain destroy buttons. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; before shots taken on the base commit (phone-play-2026-10-08) with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and committed, after shots regenerated by the runner.
